claim: Information on a murder - 1991, Washington, MO : r/RBI - Reddit
summary: I met a woman (19, I think) shortly before she was brutally murdered in Washington, MO in 1991. She was really kind to a friend and I on a pretty strange night - the night before she was killed. When I heard she had been killed by one of the men we met that same night, I was appalled and confused and all of the things one might expect.
